answer: Here is one mechanism that works: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because forge only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. In practice copper is enforced by the ledger itself: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any saffron approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
